review_comments: Do we need to check that the reviewerTeam is actually a team of this organization?
It also seems to me that the only valid team request is a ReviewTypeRequest - should we be enforcing that?

> Do we need to check that the reviewerTeam is actually a team of this organization?

Maybe not needed because the team which is not in this org won't have access permisson to the repos in this org. which won't pass previous permission check.
OK. How about the ReviewTypeRequest question?

This function appears to have changed considerably.

Why aren't you loading the reviewers anymore?

And we should still do both queries in the same transaction to prevent getting conflicting data.

> Why aren't you loading the reviewers anymore?

I think it's brtter, load it before use it by ``reviewer.LoadReviewer()`` is enough.

> And we should still do both queries in the same transaction to prevent getting conflicting data.

Hmm, I'm sorry but I can't fully understand this issue, Would you please give me more detail abut it? Thanks.

>> And we should still do both queries in the same transaction to prevent getting conflicting data.

> Hmm, I'm sorry but I can't fully understand this issue, Would you please give me more detail abut it? Thanks.

The follow two db queries should happen within a transaction (`sess.Begin()` etc.) so that you get consistent data.
